csv_project_name: AE for Accessory Dwelling Units ADUS
csv_scope_of_work: The City is seeking Qualification Statements from interested Firms registered in the State of Florida to provide professional designs for Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) to be featured on the City of Orlando website. The goal is to provide a library of pre-designed ADU plans to ease the design process for property owners and encourage ADUs within allowable zoning districts. Interested parties will be able to contact firms directly to select the design and enter into a purchase contract. All designs provided must be compatible with the existing primary structure, the surrounding neighborhood, and all applicable building and maintenance codes. Respondents are also encouraged to submit designs for ADUs that will: Feature innovative ways to reduce initial building costs and future maintenance costs. Provide a long-lasting, durable and leak-free exterior building envelope Provide higher quality interior air quality Reduce long term operating costs Address the additional design goals/requirements described in Accessory Dwelling Units Design Guidelines and Requirements below.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning

title: AE for Accessory Dwelling Units ADUs
short_description: City seeks pre-designed accessory dwelling unit plans for a public online library.
project_scope: Preparation of professional designs for accessory dwelling units (ADUs) to be published on the City of Orlando website as a library of pre-designed plans. Designs must be compatible with the existing primary structure, surrounding neighborhood, applicable building and maintenance codes, and zoning districts. The city encourages designs that reduce initial construction and future maintenance costs, provide a durable and leak-free exterior envelope, improve interior air quality, and reduce long-term operating costs.
services: Architecture services primarily; additionally requested disciplines include interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, cost estimating, and planning/master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Small-scale residential building typology with standard ADU designs.
- No indication of complex structures, long spans, bridges, roofs, or special structural systems.
- Focus is mainly architectural design library development rather than demanding structural engineering.
- Sustainability and cost-efficiency aspects are mentioned, but at a basic residential level.
- Limited strategic fit for sbp compared with bridges, sports, special structures, or large complex buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The scope concerns creation of pre-designed ADU plans rather than a specific building project. Useful cost-related information from the notice: emphasis on reducing initial building costs, maintenance costs, and operating costs; however, no unit sizes, quantities, or target budgets are provided, so no realistic project construction cost estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No design fee or budget for planning services is stated in the source. The procurement seeks qualification statements from firms to provide ADU designs for a public plan library, but no compensation structure, contract value, or anticipated engineering fee is given.
references_qualifications: Firms must be registered in the State of Florida. The notice seeks qualification statements from interested firms; no specific minimum reference projects or quantitative qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
